properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's second real-site pass: real, address-tagged OpenStreetMap building footprint for Phase I of AvalonBay Communities' three-phase Mission Bay North rental complex (255 King St, ~250 units, built circa 2003, architect Arquitectonica). 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: corrections to the description above. (1) OSM way 945538326 gives only the address (255 King Street) and building=apartments; 'Phase I of a three-phase AvalonBay complex' is not stated by it or by the Arquitectonica page, and neither uses the name 'Avalon at Mission Bay I' (AvalonBay's own 2009 release calls the earlier phase 'Avalon at Mission Bay North'); the phase numbering is this repository's label. (2) '~250 units, built circa 2003, architect Arquitectonica' is not supported as written: the Arquitectonica page describes a 407,000 SF LEED-certified development with 260 units, which matches the third phase, and gives no year; the DataSF Assessor roll (2023) for property location 255 King St (parcel 8706010) shows year built 2003, 256 units and 19 stories, and no source read names the architect of this building.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same real-geometry-without-a-single-parcel pattern already used for several Pier 70 buildings (DataSF Building Footprints) and for Mission Bay's own real park polygons.
properties.notes: The building way used here is the actual footprint; a companion OSM landuse way (867565682) may cover the same site but was not checked. That this is the 'first of three AvalonBay phases along King St' is not stated by any cited source: the name and numbering 'Avalon at Mission Bay I' are this repository's label, since OSM way 945538326 has no name and Arquitectonica titles its page 'Avalon Mission Bay'.
